description: The humanoid-robotics supply-chain cross-reference. We track which suppliers provide actuators, harmonic drives, batteries, sensors and compute to which humanoid companies, plus a specialist hardware job board.
tagline: Structured supplier data and specialist jobs for the humanoid robotics industry.
image_alt: Institute of Humanoids — The supply-chain cross-reference and hardware job board.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our editorial team tracks the hardware supply chain across the humanoid robotics industry.

editorial.testing: We track supplier data by referencing publicly disclosed hardware components, verifiable supply contracts, and direct teardowns. We do not aggregate press releases or rumours.
editorial.monetization: We make money through corporate sponsorships and paid job postings. We do not accept payment to list or alter supplier cross-references. Commission links, if used, are strictly labelled 'sponsored nofollow'.
editorial.corrections: If a hardware integration is incorrect, incomplete, or out of date, email corrections@instituteofhumanoids.com. We log corrections transparently on the relevant supplier pages.
